routeGateParityMatrix.currentSupabaseBehavior: Proxy checks Supabase claims and redirects protected /workshop requests to /login with a safe next path.
routeGateParityMatrix.betterAuthD1Requirement: Use auth.api.getSession({ headers, query: { disableCookieCache: true } }) and redirect null sessions before protected routes render.

routeGateParityMatrix.currentSupabaseBehavior: Authenticated users visiting login/signup are redirected back to the workshop shell.
routeGateParityMatrix.betterAuthD1Requirement: Use the secure Better Auth server session check rather than getSessionCookie before auth-route redirects.

routeGateParityMatrix.currentSupabaseBehavior: Closed-beta access uses the session email and redirects blocked users to /access-required.
routeGateParityMatrix.betterAuthD1Requirement: Resolve the Better Auth user email from D1-backed session identity before running the existing closed-beta policy.

routeGateParityMatrix.currentSupabaseBehavior: Terms acceptance is enforced after identity is known and before protected workshop access.
routeGateParityMatrix.betterAuthD1Requirement: Preserve the terms gate after Better Auth session validation and before setting protected-route gate headers.

routeGateParityMatrix.currentSupabaseBehavior: Invite continue, accept, and sign-out routes branch on current Supabase user context.
routeGateParityMatrix.betterAuthD1Requirement: Port invite entry to the Better Auth D1 session/user context before replacing Supabase session helpers.

routeGateParityMatrix.currentSupabaseBehavior: Local dev auth can satisfy protected routes without a live Supabase session.
routeGateParityMatrix.betterAuthD1Requirement: Keep the local dev auth gate ahead of provider-backed Better Auth session validation for local-only proof runs.

routeGateParityMatrix.currentSupabaseBehavior: Supabase callback and OTP actions own OAuth, magic-link, and sign-out provider calls.
routeGateParityMatrix.betterAuthD1Requirement: Mount Better Auth handlers and email/OAuth provider config only after D1 schema, secrets, and callback tests are ready.
